meaning.zh:
“如果情况变得最糟” 或 “在最坏的情况下”。

这个短语表达了当事情发展到最糟糕的情况时，尽可能找到应对方法的意思。它起源于人们希望即使最坏的情况发生，也能有应对策略或计划的意图。在日常对话中，这个短语常用于讨论不同的情形和应对方案时，表示已经为最坏的场景做了准备。
meaning.en: This phrase expresses the idea of finding a way to cope when things have reached their worst. It originated from the intention of having a contingency plan even if the worst happens. In everyday conversations, this idiom is often used when discussing various scenarios and responses, indicating that one has prepared for the worst-case scenario.

lines.en: If worst comes to worst, I'll use my savings to cover the expenses.
lines.zh: 如果情况变得最糟，我会用我的积蓄来支付这些费用。

lines.en: If worst comes to worst, we can always ask for help from our friends.
lines.zh: 如果情况变得最糟，我们总可以向朋友们寻求帮助。

lines.en: If worst comes to worst, we'll find another place to live.
lines.zh: 如果情况变得最糟，我们会找另一个地方住。
